tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab bdun 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag nag po'i thun gtor ni:1$0000300

gtor ma la sman rag bran la: hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje phyag rgya zil gnon dang: rgyan gyi lha brgyad yum gsum sprul pa ni: gyad gnon chen po las gshin rnam pa gsum: gshed chen sde bzhi bdud po sde bzhi dang: mon pa sde bzhi yum bcas sprul pa dang: 'chi bdag bcu gnyis sbas pa'i ma mo bzhi: bdud dang gshin rje ma mo gnod sbyin dang: dregs pa sde bzhi ro langs ma mo bzhi: bka' sdod gshin rje drug cu rtsa bzhi dang: ma gshin bdun brgya nyi shu'i tshogs dang bcas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs ma lus pa: mi mngon dbyings nas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par bzhugs: gnyis su med par gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing: dam rdzas sman raka gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las bstod: bag med nyams chag 'gal 'khrul thams cad bshags: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol ba dang: drag po mthu nus che bar mdzad du gsol: ma hā a mṛta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi:
